data.name: Faryaqqaat
data.gender_notes: Faryaqqaat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'faraqa' which means 'to divide' and 'qa'at' meaning 'wealth' or 'riches'. This name signifies being the possessor of abundant wealth or blessings. The name Faryaqqaat carries the meaning “Possessor of riches” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faryaqqaat usually hope their child will grow to embody possessor of riches and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Faryaqqaat is a name that evokes a sense of spirituality and reverence. It is a name that resonates with those who seek to connect with the divine and tap into their inner wisdom and power.
data.etymology: Faryaqqaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Possessor of riches.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faryaqqaat total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
